title: New Naruto Anime Film Announcement Expected at New York Comic Con 2026 (Variety)
content:
A new anime film for the NARUTO franchise is expected to be announced at New York Comic Con 2026, according to an exclusive report from Variety. The news will be part of a franchise panel taking place on October 10 at the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center in New York. VIZ already teased that a new project will be announced.

Variety specifically says:

“Panel highlights are expected to include an announcement related to a new animated film along with its worldwide premiere, new information and the first promotional video for the Naruto Card Game, and additional surprise announcements regarding other media developments.”

According to the teaser, NARUTO will appear at New York Comic Con on October 10, where “exciting new updates” will be revealed. Junko Takeuchi, the Japanese voice of Naruto Uzumaki, and Noriaki Sugiyama, the Japanese voice of Sasuke Uchiha, are also confirmed as special guests. Variety also reports that Studio Pierrot executive producer Yoshihiko Tominaga will be present, as well as a representative from Bandai.

ALSO READ: Interview: Naruto Composer Yasuharu Takanashi on Far East Groove EU & UK Tour

NARUTO is a manga written by Masashi Kishimoto. It began serialization in Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump in September 1999 and ran for 15 years until November 2014, ending with a total of 72 volumes. Studio Pierrot animated the anime adaptation, which premiered in October 2002 and ran for 220 episodes. The anime was followed by a sequel titled NARUTO Shippuden , which ran for 500 episodes. There is also the sequel BORUTO: NARUTO NEXT GENERATIONS manga, originally written by Ukyo Kodachi. Masashi Kishimoto later took over the story, which has illustrations by Mikio Ikimoto. The manga started in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2016 but moved to V Jump in 2019. Part 2 of the manga titled BORUTO: TWO BLUE VORTEX began in August 2023. The BORUTO: NARUTO NEXT GENERATIONS anime adaptation began broadcasting in April 2017, while the anime went on a break in March 2023. A 4-episode special was originally scheduled to broadcast for 4 consecutive weeks from September 3, 2023, but was delayed to ‘improve quality.’

A new NARUTO Card Game TCG was also recently announced for 2027, as well as a non-verbal live-action show set to run at Kyoto’s Minamiza Theater from February until June 2027. The live-action film directed by Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton recently began a cast search for Team 7’s Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura.

title: Square Enix Unveils Final Fantasy VII Revelation Game's Trailer, Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII Reunion Remaster's Switch 2 Version
content:
Square Enix unveiled during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday two trailers for games in the Final Fantasy VII series. The first video is for Final Fantasy VII Revelation , the third and final game in the Final Fantasy VII Remake trilogy, and it shows Sephiroth. The second trailer is for the Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII Reunion remastered game , and it announces the game's Nintendo Switch 2 version, which launched on the same day.

Square Enix released the Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII Reunion on PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and PC via Steam in December 2025. There is no Switch 2 upgrade path or save data transfer for customers who own the Switch version.

Final Fantasy VII Revelation will launch on April 8 simultaneously for PS5, Xbox X|S, Xbox on PC, Switch 2, and PC via Steam and Epic Games Store.

Square Enix released the Final Fantasy VII Remake game on PS4 in April 2020 after a delay from March 2020. The game was a PlayStation exclusive until April 2021. The game's new Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade version with additional content launched in June 2021 on PS5, December 2021 on PC via the Epic Games Store, and June 2022 on PC via Steam . The game received a release for Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox PC, and Xbox Cloud on January 22.

Final Fantasy VII Rebirth debuted worldwide in February 2024 on two discs for PS5. The game then launched on PC via Steam and Epic Games Store in January 2025. The game launched for Switch 2, Xbox X|S, and Xbox on PC on June 3.

title: Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko's Mystery Dungeon Game's HD Version Announced for Same Day Release
content:
Square Enix announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream a release of the Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko's Mystery Dungeon -Classic HD- game for the first time in the West. The game launched on the same day as the announcement for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam . The company streamed an announcement trailer and an opening movie trailer. In related news, Square Enix also streamed a trailer for its Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World game , revealing a playable demo launch.

The original Torneko's Great Adventure: Mystery Dungeon game debuted for Super Famicon in September 1993 in Japan. The roguelike adventure game stars Torneko, a merchant from the Dragon Quest IV game for NES and Famicom.

The Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World Demo Trailer game will launch for Switch 2, Switch, PS5, Xbox X|S, and PC via Steam and Windows on December 3.

The game stars Bianca and Nera from the Dragon Quest V: Hand of the Heavenly Bride title. Debora from the same game also appears. There are over 500 monsters. The game's Japanese name is Dragon Quest Monsters 4: Kareki no Kuni no Bianca・Flora (Bianca and Flora in the Withered World). Flora is Nera's original Japanese name.

title: 17 Years Ago, One of Anime’s Biggest Franchises Ever Changed the World & Fans Want More
content:
At the cusp of the 2010s, anime and manga had begun to explode in popularity around the world. What was once considered a relatively niche hobby space was rapidly becoming more mainstream, with many shows, like Naruto , One Piece and Bleach becoming recognizable, even for those who wouldn’t typically consider themselves fans of the genre. This titanic shift in popularity became seismic with the release of Attack on Titan on September 9, 2009 .

Attack on Titan , created by Hajime Isayama, began serialization in Bessatsu Shonen Magazine and followed Eren Yaeger, a young boy living within the confines of Wall Maria in Shiganshina, hiding away from the threat of mysterious monsters known as Titans. Attack on Titan ‘s signature , captivating art style wasn’t the only thing the debut series had going for it, though, as the story immediately thrusts readers into just how grim the series’ dark fantasy setting is as the wall protecting Eren, his family, and the other civilians residing in Shiganshina is demolished by a 60-meter tall titan, causing the city to be ravaged by Titans.

How Attack On Titan Went From Cult Hit To Worldwide Sensation

While Attack on Titan ‘s original manga didn’t become an overnight megahit in the same way as shonen’s “Big Three,” the series received glowing accolades as quickly as 2011, when it received the 35th Kodansha Manga Award in the shonen category. From there, before Wit Studio’s anime adaptation was announced, Attack on Titan began steadily climbing sales charts in Japan, earning a solid top 15 spot for sales in 2012 with roughly 800,000 copies in circulation. When the first season of the anime adaptation produced by Wit Studio premiered in April 2013, sales for Attack on Titan skyrocketed, jumping to having close to 24 million copies in circulation by September that same year, and was ranked as 2nd best-selling manga at the time.

During the 2010s, anime had become far more accessible for fans in North America and Europe. The surge in popularity anime was having overall thanks to the rise of streaming platforms licensing new series led to Attack on Titan ‘s anime adaptation being simulcast by Crunchyroll and Funimation as the series was being broadcast in Japan. This approach caused Attack on Titan to explode in popularity around the globe. In December 2020, when the anime adaptation of the manga’s final arc began on Crunchyroll, traffic to watch the new season was so high it caused the streaming service to crash. By the time Attack on Titan ‘s finale released in November 2023, the manga had over 120 million copies in circulation, with Parrot Analytics reporting that demand for the series was 68 times greater than the average television series at the time.

Attack On Titan ‘s Heartbreaking Tale of Freedom Made Fans Fall In Love With Its Characters

Attack on Titan ‘s core themes observe the cost of freedom , and the complex choices that individuals make when faces with inescapable horrors, and the grim reality of war. Yes, there are fantastical creatures threatening the livelihoods of the main cast, and there is a major plot twist toward the end of the series introducing a chicken-and-egg paradox to explain the plot threads leading Eren to get his Titan abilities. Because of these elements, fans of Attack on Titan are able to see exactly what it is that Hajime Isayama is trying to say through Eren’s character arc and through the final moments of the series.

Eren’s progression as a character not only tackles the brutal effects of generational trauma, showing how Eren has inherited a cycle of bloodshed from those that came before him. The series also masterfully shows the inevitability of his own fractured determinism. Audiences see Eren in the first arc of Attack on Titan criticizing the complacency of the people living within the Walls, and yearns to travel beyond them with the Survey Corps to learn more about how to fight back against the threat of Titans.

This ambition, in a twist of tragic irony, ends up caging Eren as a beacon of hope for everyone around him as he must sacrifice his own freedom and humanity to set the world free of the broken cycle its trapped in. The lengths Attack on Titan was willing to go to illustrate its brutally hopeful narrative has left a lingering effect on the anime and manga communities, and discussions surrounding the series likely won’t be disappearing anytime soon.

title: Square Enix Announces Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United Remake Game
content:
Square Enix annnounced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday that the 1995 Romancing SaGa 3 game is getting a remake titled Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam on February 16. The company unveiled two trailers:

The remake features 3D graphics, refined gameplay, newly arranged music, and voice acting. The game features eight protagonists (Mikhail, Monika, Katarina, Khalid, Julian, Thomas, Sarah, Ellen), 20 recruitable companions, and the "Glimmer" system for acquiring new abilities.

Square Enix describes the story:

Set in a world caught in a devastating cosmic cycle known as the Rise of Morastrum, which occurs once every 300 years and claims the life of everyone born that year except a single survivor known as the Child of Destiny, players will choose between eight heroes bound by fate. A little over a dozen years after the last disaster, the Four Sinistrals have returned, seeking to reopen the Abyss Gates and bring ruin to the world. On their journey to save the world, players can choose which lands to visit, which stories to pursue and the order in which to confront the Sinistrals, ensuring a unique adventure with every playthrough.

Romancing SaGa 3 debuted for Super Famicom in 1995. The remastered version of the game launched for PlayStation 4, PlayStation Vita, Switch, Xbox One, PC, iOS, and Android in November 2019.

The Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven HD remake game launched digitally for Switch, PS5, PlayStation 4, and PC via Steam , as well as physically for Switch and PS5, in October 2024. The game got a Switch 2 Edition in August 2025.

Square released the first Romancing SaGa game in 1992 for the Super Famicom (SNES) game console. An enhanced remake of the game for the PlayStation 2 titled Romancing SaGa: Minstrel Song launched in Japan and North America in 2005. A ported version of the original Super Famicom game launched for mobile phones and digitally for Nintendo Wii in 2009. The Romancing SaGa 2 sequel game launched for Super Famicom in 1993. The remastered version of the game launched for PS4, PS Vita, Switch, Xbox One, and PC worldwide in December 2017.

title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Game's Trailers Reveal Switch 2 Version, Tokyo Revengers DLC Characters
content:
SNK announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday that it will release its Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves fighting game for Nintendo Switch 2 digitally on October 22 and physically in January 2027. The videos also reveal that Manjiro Sano and Ken Ryuguji from the Tokyo Revengers anime will join the game as DLC characters in Season 3:

Season 3 launched on July 23 with six characters joining the roster in the next five months. Rick Strowd joined the game on July 23. Duck King launched on August 27. The game will add Kim Kaphwan in September and Laocorn in November, as well as the Tokyo Revengers collaboration characters. SNK teased new characters in an animated trailer in July.

Kim Jae Hoon, the first DLC character for Season Pass 2 in Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves , launched on January 22. Nightmare Geese launched on February 26, and Blue Mary debuted on March 26. Wolfgang Krauser debuted in the game on April 24, coinciding with the game's first anniversary. DLC character Mr. Karate launched on May 27. Kenshiro from Fist of the North Star debuted in the game on June 28

The game debuted in April 2025 for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store.

The game's crossover with Street Fighter includes characters Ken and Chun-Li. Both characters are a part of the game's Season Pass 1. The game launched Andy Bogard as a playable character in June 2025, added Ken as a playable character in August 2025, introduced Joe Higashi as a playable character in October 2025, debuted Chun-Li in November 2025, and launched MR. BIG in December 2025.

The game added real-life DJ Salvatore Ganacci, professional soccer player Cristiano Ronaldo, and Hokutomaru. Other returning characters include Terry Bogard, Rock Howard, Tizoc, Hotaru Futaba, Marco Rodrigues, B. Jenet, Kevin Rian, Billy Kane, Mai Shiranui, Kim Dong Hwan, and Gato. The game also includes the new characters Preecha and Vox Reaper.

SNK announced the new game at the EVO fighting game tournament in 2022. It is the first new game in more than two decades since the last installment.

Fatal Fury (known as Garō Densetsu in Japan) is one of SNK 's most iconic fighting game franchises, and is the origin of some of the company's most recognizable characters, including Terry Bogard, Andy Bogard, Mai Shiranui, Blue Mary, Geese Howard, and more. Fatal Fury: King of Fighters debuted in arcades in 1991, and the latest installment, Garou: Mark of the Wolves , debuted in 1999. SNK 's separate fighting game franchise The King of Fighters initially began as a crossover fighter for SNK 's Fatal Fury and Art of Fighting franchises, and their characters have been mainstays in the long-running series until today.

The series inspired the Fatal Fury: Legend of the Hungry Wolf OVA in 1992, Fatal Fury 2: The New Battle OVA in 1993, and Fatal Fury: The Motion Picture in 1994. All three feature Masami Ōbari 's character designs, with Ōbari also directing the third anime. Discotek Media has released all three anime.

title: 9 Years Later, Major Crunchyroll Isekai Returns for New English Dub Release
content:
A major Isekai franchise has finally returned for a new season of episodes after nine long years, and Crunchyroll has now kicked off its English dub release for the comeback. Crunchyroll has been rounding out the final wave of episodes for the Summer 2026 anime slate through the course of the rest of the month, and that also includes the start of some of the most anticipated new English dub releases in their schedule too . But there’s been one English dub return that fans have been (technically) waiting nearly a decade for.

Yojo Senki: Saga of Tanya the Evil finally made its long awaited comeback with Season 2 of the anime this Summer , and fans had waited nine years since the end of the first season for that to happen. But while it has been airing the Japanese language release, fans of the English dub had been having to wait for their chance to see it all in action. Thankfully that’s no longer the case as Crunchyroll has officially kicked off the English dub release for Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2 on Wednesday, September 9th.

Crunchyroll Confirms Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2 English Dub Release Date

The English dub release for Yojo Senki: Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2 will be officially kicking off its run with Crunchyroll on September 9th with its premiere episode, and new episodes will then be streaming with the platform on a weekly basis. It also features a returning cast from the first season (which is even more impressive considering how long it’s been since that debut season) with the likes of Monica Rial as Tanya Degurechaff, Jeannie Tirado as Viktoriya Ivanova Serebryakov, Jason Douglas as Hans, J. Michael Tatum as Erich, Barry Yandell as Loria, David Matranga as William, Tia Ballard as Mary Sue and more.

The first season of the anime series originally came to an end back in 2017 , so it’s great to see the show making its return for these new episodes after all this time. Saga of Tanya the Evil has remained one of Kadokawa’s main Isekai pillars through the decade, however, as it was seen in the Isekai Quartet crossover. That show ended up being such a hit that it had multiple seasons and even a feature film release of its own. But this is a proper return for the main series at last.

What to Know for Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2

Yojo Senki: Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2 made its debut this July as part of the Summer 2026 anime schedule, and unfortunately won’t be sticking around for much longer. Like many of the other new anime releases that made their premieres this Summer, Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2 is only a single cour of episodes that will be wrapping up through the rest of the month. It’s to make room for the new wave of anime coming this October.

It might have been nearly a decade since the release of the first season, but the original production staff all made their return for the new episodes. Tanya is getting closer to eventually taking her revenge on the god that put her in this war torn world, and it’s only getting much more complicated from here. Make sure to check it all out with Crunchyroll now that the English dub has kicked off.

Crunchyroll has been rounding out the final wave of episodes for the Summer 2026 anime slate through the course of the rest of the month, and that also includes the start of some of the most anticipated new English dub releases in their schedule too . But there’s been one English dub return that fans have been (technically) waiting nearly a decade for.

Yojo Senki: Saga of Tanya the Evil finally made its long awaited comeback with Season 2 of the anime this Summer , and fans had waited nine years since the end of the first season for that to happen. But while it has been airing the Japanese language release, fans of the English dub had been having to wait for their chance to see it all in action. Thankfully that’s no longer the case as Crunchyroll has officially kicked off the English dub release for Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2 on Wednesday, September 9th.
Crunchyroll Confirms Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2 English Dub Release Date

The English dub release for Yojo Senki: Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2 will be officially kicking off its run with Crunchyroll on September 9th with its premiere episode, and new episodes will then be streaming with the platform on a weekly basis. It also features a returning cast from the first season (which is even more impressive considering how long it’s been since that debut season) with the likes of Monica Rial as Tanya Degurechaff, Jeannie Tirado as Viktoriya Ivanova Serebryakov, Jason Douglas as Hans, J. Michael Tatum as Erich, Barry Yandell as Loria, David Matranga as William, Tia Ballard as Mary Sue and more.

The first season of the anime series originally came to an end back in 2017 , so it’s great to see the show making its return for these new episodes after all this time. Saga of Tanya the Evil has remained one of Kadokawa’s main Isekai pillars through the decade, however, as it was seen in the Isekai Quartet crossover. That show ended up being such a hit that it had multiple seasons and even a feature film release of its own. But this is a proper return for the main series at last.
What to Know for Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2

Yojo Senki: Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2 made its debut this July as part of the Summer 2026 anime schedule, and unfortunately won’t be sticking around for much longer. Like many of the other new anime releases that made their premieres this Summer, Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2 is only a single cour of episodes that will be wrapping up through the rest of the month. It’s to make room for the new wave of anime coming this October.

It might have been nearly a decade since the release of the first season, but the original production staff all made their return for the new episodes. Tanya is getting closer to eventually taking her revenge on the god that put her in this war torn world, and it’s only getting much more complicated from here. Make sure to check it all out with Crunchyroll now that the English dub has kicked off.

title: Marvelous Announces Eternal Anima Game for Switch 2, PS5, Xbox X|S, PC
content:
Marvelous announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday a new JRPG titled Eternal Anima , formerly known as Project Life is RPG . The game launches for Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam on March 4.

The company describes the story:

Yearning for a better future is considered a capital offence in the kingdom of Urvis Ael. After Wade questions this key tenet of his society, he finds himself on the run in an era-spanning adventure that challenges his core beliefs and reveals an unknown world filled with hidden truths. Alongside an eclectic group of new allies trying to survive a dangerous journey, Wade must travel through time to save civilisations of the past from catastrophes and unravel the secrets of a lost history.

The protagonist Wade can use the power of Psychometry to predict enemy actions and battle outcomes. Wade can also inherit the abilities and classes of heroes from the past.

Katsuhisa Higuchi is directing the game with story concept writer Keisuke Makino and scenario writer Kazushige Nojima .

Marvelous originally announced this game as Project Life is RPG in May 2023, stating that this was inspired by classic JRPGs.

title: Ninja Scroll 4K Remaster Sets October 4, 5 and 7 North American Theatrical Release, Exclusive Still Available
content:
Tickets are now on sale for the limited North American theatrical release of the new 4K remaster of Ninja Scroll , with screenings scheduled for October 4, 5 and 7, 2026 in the United States and Canada.

HIDIVE and Iconic Events Releasing will present the three-day run in approximately 600 theaters. The October 4 screening will be available with English subtitles, October 5 will feature the English dub, and the October 7 encore will offer either format depending on the theater. Anime Corner has the opportunity to exclusively share a still from the remaster:

The restoration was supervised by writer and director Yoshiaki Kawajiri and produced by Sentai. The remaster began with a 4K scan of the original 35mm negative at 3840 × 2160 resolution, followed by frame-by-frame damage repair and color correction to create a new archival-quality digital master.

Originally released in 1993 and produced by Madhouse, Ninja Scroll follows Jubei after he saves a young ninja woman and becomes drawn into an investigation surrounding the mysterious deaths of an entire village. The pair soon uncover a larger conspiracy involving supernatural enemies determined to stop them.

The upcoming screenings are being promoted as the first opportunity for North American audiences to see the newly remastered 4K version of the film in theaters.

title: SSS-Class Revival Hunter Manhwa Announces Anime Adaptation for January 2027, Reveals First Teaser, Visual, Cast
content:
The anime adaptation of SSS-Class Revival Hunter will premiere in January 2027, with a teaser visual, first trailer, main cast and staff also revealed. Crunchyroll has confirmed that it will stream the series internationally.

Takeo Otsuka stars as Kim Gongja, with Satoshi Hino voicing the Sword Emperor.

Gongja begins as an F-rank Hunter before obtaining an S+ rank copy skill that activates upon his death. After witnessing a scandal involving the Flame Emperor, the highest-ranked Hunter, Gongja is killed. He subsequently makes use of a copied ability that sends him back 24 hours whenever he dies, setting him on a path of revenge and eventually toward becoming one of the strongest Hunters.

The Sword Emperor is a former top-class Hunter who becomes Gongja’s ghostly companion through his copy skill. After recognizing Gongja’s potential, he begins supporting him as his partner, with the series following the pair as they pursue greater strength together.

Hiroaki Sakurai, known for The Disastrous Life of Saiki K. , is directing the anime at STUDIO fu. Sayuri Oba is in charge of the script, while Takahiro Yoshimatsu is serving as character designer.

Hiroaki Sakurai, known for The Disastrous Life of Saiki K. , is directing the anime at STUDIO fu. Sayuri Oba is handling the scripts, while Takahiro Yoshimatsu is serving as character designer. Sakurai commented:

“The original work began as a novel before expanding into a comic and gaining popularity around the world. It is an honor to be able to adapt it into an anime, but at the same time, I also feel the pressure. But! The moment Takahiro Yoshimatsu was chosen as character designer, I felt as though the path toward the anime adaptation suddenly became much wider and clearer. With the staff, cast, and the power of the music further strengthening and paving that road, I feel like we are now steadily moving forward with production.”

Oba commented:

“SSS-Class Revival Hunter is a popular Korean work that excels at roller coaster-style dramatic developments. At the beginning, the protagonist Gongja is a low-ranking Hunter. However, he learns to make use of the card he obtains and rises through the ranks through a truly ‘die and live again’ cheat-like method. I hope you enjoy its unpredictable and original story every episode. I believe both longtime fans of the original work and those experiencing the series for the first time will be satisfied.”

Yoshimatsu commented:

“When I received the request to handle the character designs and looked through the original work, I found so many appealing characters! I immediately felt the urge to draw them. I thought, ‘This contains exactly the nutrients Yoshimatsu needs right now.’ I’m only participating in the designs for the main characters, but I’m happy to be working with Director Sakurai again after such a long time.”

Crunchyroll will stream SSS-Class Revival Hunter in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS, the Indian Subcontinent, Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia and Singapore.

The original Korean webcomic by Shin Noah and illustrated by Bill K debuted in December 2020 and has released 151 episodes to date. An English-language edition is available through Tapas.
